name: Card
purpose: Rounded container for grouped content: settings groups, the note card and the attachments empty box. Folds in SettingsGroup: Card's purpose already names settings groups. Add a label prop so the container takes role=group labelled by it (Card's role entry already reads group when labelled). Add a header slot or discard-pending-change action prop for SettingsGroup's discard button. SettingsGroup's state and context axes become Card props, and the result stays a container only. Both are shadcn Card containers.

values.when: No fill (window or pane colour). B's value; the note card if its fill is not confirmed.
bg-surface-2. Default fill: settings group card; note card assumed (A). B's raised folded here.
Sunken fill: attachments empty box. Kept distinct because the sunken box is visibly different.
1px border-edge-2 (B's edge). Settings group card, note card.
Dashed border: attachments empty box. Kept (visible; B folded it to solid).
No pending change. No dot, no discard action.
A change is pending and onDiscard is provided. Shows the changed dot and the discard action. Not a recorded catalogue state; the catalogue lists it as onDiscard-driven (B).
A settings pane group or a shortcut scope group.
A search result. The label becomes the breadcrumb path (for example 'General · Appearance') and only matching child rows render.

props.name: divided
props.description: Hairline between child rows (divide-y edge-1), used by settings groups.

props.name: label
props.description: Group heading (Appearance, Tasks, Screenshots, Global, Main window, Capture bar).

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Search-result path, for example 'General · Appearance'. Shown only in the search context (B's separate prop).

props.name: hint
props.description: Secondary line. Only the Global group has one in the reference: 'work anywhere in macOS'.

props.name: changed
props.description: Shows the change dot when a change is pending.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: Discard action, shown when changed is true.

states: emptied and blurred (note discard, owned by NoteCard)
changed (dot and discard action; only while a change is pending and onDiscard is set)
search result (breadcrumb label, matching child rows only)
keyboard: None on the container; children own keys.
open: Note card fill conflict: A assumes surface-2; B says base (colour not in elements.json). Designer to confirm. Note and settings card radius not measured (panel assumed). Attachments empty box is h-20 and holds two buttons split by a level-2 Separator (length fill). The lightbox fallback card is an EmptyState surface card (A), not Card; B listed it here, so the replaces string is kept on EmptyState. The discard-on-empty-blur rule is NoteCard behaviour, not Card.
